layer_bands.note: not drawn: 7 per cent of the cells carrying this label lie inside no layer mesh at all, and 16 per cent lie deeper than layer 4, so the band spans almost the whole cortex

fields.NSp: Number of dendritic spine skeleton nodes
fields.NAis: Number of axon initial segment skeleton nodes
fields.NMy: Number of myelinated axon skeleton nodes
fields.Sp: Spinyness (ratio of spines to dendrite skeleton nodes)

derived.volume_um3: NVx x 8x8x33 nm, the release's own voxel size
derived.soma_um: position of this cell's soma in c3/tables/somas.csv
derived.soma_depth_um: distance to the outward surface of the release's layer 1 region, a 0.31 mm2 patch of 1549 faces from gs://h01-release/data/20210601/layers
